This beta fixes audio-language source selection, search filtering, inline-trailer focus sounds, and shelf focus return from View More.

- Audio source changes remain pinned to the requested language and do not fall back to another language.
- Search opens on Movies and offers only Movies and Series filters.
- Trailer preview dismissal moves focus to the adjacent title card with a single navigation cue.
- Left from View More returns to the immediately preceding title card in finite and looping shelves.
- Trailer previews start at 10 seconds by default.
- CI Kotlin compilation has a larger daemon heap and bounded worker concurrency to avoid release-build OOM.
